plain_definition: A role the UK government created to lead industry towards tokenising wholesale (institutional) financial markets, under the July 2025 Wholesale Financial Markets Digital Strategy. The Champion convenes a cross-industry taskforce, reports to the Chancellor twice over an 18-month term, and is a private-sector appointee rather than a regulator or civil servant.
formal_definition: A role established under the Wholesale Financial Markets Digital Strategy (HM Treasury, 15 July 2025) to provide market leadership on tokenisation of UK wholesale capital markets and co-ordinate the sector's wider implementation of digitalisation, per the role's Terms of Reference. The government appointed Chris Woolard CBE -- a partner at Ernst & Young (EY) and former interim Chief Executive of the FCA -- to the role. Deliverables set out in the Terms of Reference are a cross-industry taskforce, an initial forward look (by July 2026), and a report on DLT adoption and interoperability (by July 2027), over an 18-month term.
